{{Quote|The Imperial Star Destroyers ''Bombard'' and ''Crusader'' limped back to Ord Grovner Naval Base this week after dealing a death-blow to the arrogant and once-almighty Eyttyrmin Pirates of the Khuiumin system.|[[TriNebulon News/Legends|TriNebulon News]]|<ref name="Adventure">{{JournalCite|6|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref>}}
The '''Khuiumin system''' was located in the [[Khuiumin sector/Legends|Khuiumin sector]]. It contained [[Courkrus]].
